capabilities: Delete all notes matching the current search results in one action
Trigger deletion from the search results count menu or the Tags view
Respect the vault's Deleted files setting (system trash, .trash, or permanent)
Keep attachments linked from deleted notes
Warn which deletion mode applies and disable the menu while search runs
extras: Relies on the undocumented internal search:results-menu event, so the Delete item may stop appearing after Obsidian updates; installable via BRAT and release files can be verified with gh attestation.
problem: Obsidian's search can match many notes at once, but deleting them still has to be done file by file.
summary: Bulk-delete tool that removes every note in the current search results at once, for example all notes sharing a tag.
